sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id)
       mdp.gender                  AS sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.client_id) AS patient_count
FROM (SELECT client_id
      FROM (SELECT client_id,
                   obs_datetime,
                   adherence_code,
                   @good_streak := IF(@prev_client = client_id, IF(adherence_code = 'good', @good_streak + 1, 0),
                                      IF(adherence_code = 'good', 1, 0)) AS good_streak,
                   @prev_client := client_id
            FROM (SELECT *
                  FROM mamba_fact_non_suppressed_obs_group
                  WHERE obs_datetime >= :startDate AND obs_datetime < :endDate
